items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: he asked of one of Johnny Beboleyn's children.

ctx.x: Suzanne. She doesn't like Susan. But her name was Suzanne LeBlanc. And she was a grand old lady of the whole family. She had this big plantation home that her husband died in her four-post bed. And he was a white man. He was a pure white man. You want me to tell? Sure. You want me to tell her why? She was a nurse. And so she took care of his face with, um, I think he had four boys. One just recently died out there in, uh, Ascension Parish. I'm sorry I didn't get to see him. Because he asked for me. One, not me,…
